text:
Cheryl Casone of FBN on Facebook's change to its news feed (screen grab via FBN ). 
"It's Facebook, Stupid" In a recent article, I mentioned that two institutional investors in Apple ( AAPL ) had questioned that company's role in smartphone addiction. Seeking Alpha contributor Julian Alexander, riffing on James Carville's famous phrase , commented, "It's Facebook, stupid". Events since suggest Alexander may have been right. I elaborate below, and present a couple of ways Facebook ( FB ) shareholders can stay long while limiting their risk. First, a quick recap of the smartphone addiction issue. 
Is Apple Big Tobacco -- Or Just The Wrapper For It? The Wall Street Journal broke the news last weekend (paywalled here ) that two of Apple's institutional investors, activists JANA Partners and one of the world's largest pension funds, CalSTRS , asked Apple to study "research effects on young people of smartphone overuse and addiction".
